title: CF Roadmap Sync Prep - Mar 2026 (John)
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (product + eng + applied ML) - prep notes
Date: 2026-03-09 weekly sync (note: send updated deck by EOD 3/8)
Attendees (expected): Priya (PM), Maya (Eng lead), Arun (Applied ML), Ethan (SRE), me (John) + optional: Lina (data infra)
Goals for this sync:
- Align on priorities for H2 roadmap slices that impact inference runtime and model onboarding
- Surface major blockers (capacity, model performance regressions, licensing)
- Decide on roll-forward policy for quantized variants (canary vs staged rollout)
- Agree owners & dates for short-term wins (batching tweaks, prefix cache experiments)

Prep / what I need to bring:
- Short one-slide summary of infra constraints: current Dedicated capacity utilization, P95 latency by route, top 5 heavy tenants (INF-4123)
- Two proposed rollout plans for quantization (A = aggressive canary, B = conservative staged) with risk bullets
- List of 3 prompt-eval failures from last week and suggested mitigations

Agenda (30-40m):
1) Quick status (5m) - Priya: product priorities, Maya: infra health
2) Data/metrics (5m) - John: latency/cost hotspots, Ethan: SRE incidents last 30d
3) Model onboarding roadmap (10m) - Arun + research: new open models, perf profiles, eval gaps
4) Rollout policy decision (10m) - pick plan A or B or hybrid, identify canary cohort
5) Action items & owners (5m)

Key points to raise / talking bullets:
- Product wants faster time-to-ship for new lightweight models (lower P50) but we must quantify quality trade-offs. Ask: what quality delta is acceptable for user-facing chat endpoints? (Priya to propose baseline)
- Eng: current autoscaling policy causes oscillation for large batched workloads - propose a short experiment: increase cooldown from 30s -> 90s for GPU pool X (Maya to own)
- Research: quantized 4-bit variant shows ~1.4x cost reduction but occasional token-level hallucination on proprietary prompt set (Arun)
- Need clarity on canary cohort definition: % traffic, tenant selection, rollback criteria (SLO breach threshold)

Open questions to surface:
- Rolling back quantized model: do we have a fast fallback to FP16 variant without cache invalidation? (tech note: KV cache semantics)
- Licensing: one of the proposed open models may require additional attribution - legal ok? (linked JIRA: LEG-78)
- Cost allocation: how to divide savings across product owners when we enable batching at platform layer? (finance input needed)

Metrics / slides to include (one-line each):
- P50/P95 latency per route (last 7d)
- Tokens/sec per GPU and avg batch size distribution
- Top 10 routes by cost/token and by traffic
- Quality eval: pass rate on core prompt set (baseline vs quantized)

Proposed decisions (for quick vote):
- Rollout policy: choose conservative staged rollout (Plan B) with 5% traffic canary -> 25% after 48h if no SLO/regression alerts
- Autoscaling experiment: increase cooldown for GPU pool X -> monitor for 2 weeks
- Prefix cache TTL tweak: lower TTL for long-tail tenants to reduce stale KV growth (Maya + Ethan to test)

Action items (rough list - convert to Jira after meeting):
- John: prepare single slide with P95/P50 by route + top 5 tenants (due 2026-03-08 EOD)
- Maya: propose autoscaling cooldown experiment config + expected risk mitigation (due 2026-03-10)
- Arun: run 1000-prompt eval for quantized-4bit vs FP16 on our core prompt set; summary + regression examples (due 2026-03-12)
- Priya: confirm acceptable quality delta threshold for product endpoints and share with team (due 2026-03-11)
- Ethan: validate rollback path for model variants (verify cache behavior) and add SRE runbook note (due 2026-03-12)
- Lina (optional): check if BI can provide cost-allocation model for batching savings (due 2026-03-15)

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Long term: unified rollout manager that handles model variant matching, gradual traffic ramp, and canary cohorts per tenant (product + eng roadmap item)
- Need a short doc describing canary criteria and measurement plan (I'll start a Confluence stub: confluence:CF-roadmap-2026)

Notes to self / meeting tactics:
- Keep rollout decision scoped: pick parameters now, avoid re-opening design at this sync
- If pushback on Plan B from product, offer hybrid: 5% canary + targeted tenant opt-in (only for low-sensitivity customers)
- Record exact rollback criteria in meeting notes (SLO breach X% or quality eval drop Y points)

Relevant links / tickets to paste into chat before meeting:
- JIRA INF-4123 (capacity / heavy tenants)
- JIRA LEG-78 (model licensing question)
- GitHub: repo/roadmap-proposals#45 (quantization rollout plan)
- Confluence: CF-roadmap-2026 (stub)

Rough timeline for next 6 weeks (proposal):
- Week 1: decide rollout policy + autoscaling experiment kick-off
- Week 2-3: canary rollout for quantized variant on non-critical routes (monitor)
- Week 4: evaluate results, decide broader rollout or rollback
- Week 6: post-mortem & updated plan for Dedicated capacity adjustments

Short personal checklist before sync:
- [ ] update slide deck (metrics + proposals)
- [ ] DM Priya & Arun for any last-minute asks
- [ ] ensure SLO dashboards are pinned and shared

End of notes.
